newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Patterson estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Patterson estimates raised.

text.p: - EVEREN Securities analyst Kevin Silverman said he raised his earnings estimates for Patterson Dental Co based on an improved outlook for the dental products distributor. Results are expected to benefit from a resumption of dental equipment sales and contributions from a recent acquisition of a health care forms business.
- Silverman said he raised Patterson's fiscal 1997 (April 30) earnings estimate to $1.48 a share from $1.40 and fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.72 from $1.60.
- He repeated an intermediate and long term outperform rating.
- Shares of Patterson Dental are trading unchanged at 27-1/2.
